user_setting.label: Client ID
user_setting.help: Client ID of the organization API key, from the Bitwarden Admin Console under Settings > Organization info > API Key.

password_setting.label: Client secret
password_setting.help: Client secret of the organization API key, from the Bitwarden Admin Console under Settings > Organization info > API Key.

base_url_setting.label: Self-hosted instance URL
base_url_setting.help: The domain of your self-hosted Bitwarden instance, required only for self-hosted Bitwarden setups. The instance must be publicly accessible via HTTPS. Example: vault.example.com, 123.123.123.123:8443.

additional_config_fields.label: Cloud Region
additional_config_fields.help: Only used when instance type is Cloud.
